youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Jesus replies to your comment. Bible verse for when forgiveness doesn't feel finished.

A viewer wrote: "I forgave her but I can't let her back in, and it left me hollow."

She: Jesus... I forgave her. I just can't let her back in. 🥀
She: Now I feel hollow, like forgiving should have fixed everything.
Jesus: Forgiving her was letting go of the debt. Trust grows back slowly, if it can.
She: So am I still holding a grudge?
Jesus: You're not paying her back. You're guarding a wound that's still healing.
Jesus: As much as lies in you. Not more than you have. I'll sit with you in that hollow place.

“If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.”
Romans 12:18 (KJV)
